newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish fin min Niinisto to meet French financiers.
newsitem.headline: Finnish fin min Niinisto to meet French financiers.

text.p: Finnish finance minister Sauli Niinisto will travel to Paris on March 17 for talks with institutional investors about Finland's government borrowing, the finance ministry said in a statement on Friday.
"The visit is part of an investors meeting programme related to state borrowing, the goal of which is to secure competitive loan financing from the international capital markets," the ministry said.

On March 18, Niinisto will give a presentation on Finland's economic policy and economic outlook to more than 80 representatives of French insurance institutions, pension funds and investment companies, the ministry said.
"The programme also includes one-on-one meetings with France's biggest institutional investors," it said.
